title: random-prompt settings
description: What this plugin picks from, and how much it asks for back.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: One is chosen at random each time the tool runs. Keep them simple enough to answer without thinking, so a slow reply means the pipeline is wrong rather than the question being hard.

answer_style.title: Answer style
answer_style.description: Sent along with the subject so the model knows how much to say.
